title: Roast Chicken Pesto Ciabatta
description: Leftover roast chicken, basil pesto and melted mozzarella pressed between grilled ciabatta — a ten-minute lunch.

ingredients.name: roasted red pepper
ingredients.note: from a jar, drained and sliced

steps.text: Heat the oven grill to high. Cut the ciabatta in half horizontally and toast the cut sides, 1–2 minutes, until lightly golden.
Spread the pesto generously over both toasted faces.
Pile the shredded chicken, mozzarella and roasted pepper onto the bottom half.
Grill open-faced for 2–3 minutes until the mozzarella melts and starts to bubble.
Pile on the rocket, close the sandwich and press gently so the filling stays put.
Cut in half on the diagonal and serve warm.

notesMarkdown:
## Making ahead

Assemble (without the rocket) the night before and keep wrapped in the fridge.
Grill cold — the ciabatta gets properly crisp as it heats through.

## Swaps

- **Pesto:** sun-dried-tomato or rocket pesto work just as well.
- **Chicken:** sliced grilled halloumi makes a great vegetarian version.
- Add **grilled courgette ribbons** when they are in season.

media.alt: Freshly made ciabatta sandwich with cheese, tomato and herbs on a rustic wooden table
